title: The time for fence-sitting is over. 🔥
paragraphs: The time for fence-sitting is over. 🔥
As we face these uncertain times, the true state of our hearts is being revealed. Will your faith stand the test, or will it be found wanting?
"So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I will spit you out of my mouth." - Revelation 3:16
It’s time to kindle the fire within. Let your light shine in the darkness and choose a side. 💡
Follow @iamGospelWarrior for daily truth, strength, and inspiration. ⚔️
